subject: Cortex Launch with Seven Agents - One data problem
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Saw Cortex launch this week. Training a VLM on construction drawings while running document agents in parallel means two distinct data problems: labelled drawing sheets for the vision side, and output review to catch wrong answers before they reach a GC on a live project.

We worked with OnsiteIQ on their construction vision models. After moving their annotation and data infrastructure to Encord they hit 5x faster data throughput and cut project setup from 2 months to 2 weeks.

The pattern we see at teams your stage: the internal tooling that got you to launch stops scaling when model count and project volume rise at the same time. The slow part stops being generating outputs and starts being closing the loop between a model getting something wrong and a corrected example making it back into training.

Worth 20 minutes to talk through how you're handling that on the drawing side?

Please let me know.
